name: timber-app
description: Desktop app for Timber: every worktree, agent, and terminal in one window.

scripts.start: electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun dev
scripts.dev: electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun dev --watch
scripts.dev:hmr: concurrently --kill-others --success first "bun run hmr" "bun run start"
scripts.build: bun scripts/fetch-timber.ts && electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.build:canary: bun scripts/fetch-timber.ts && electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun build --env=canary
